title: Medtronic | HTN:RDN
overview: Helping explain the benefits of Renal Denervation as an adjunctive therapy for treating Hypertension.
testimonial: “Made Clear Studios are timely, committed, inclusive and flexible. They’re easy to work with, they have great thought processes, and I know that they’ll solve any problems I have.”
authorRoleLine1: Principal Market Development Manager, Cardiac & Vascular Group Global Renal Denervation
body1:
This project for Medtronic, aimed to rebuild confidence in Renal Denervation (RDN) as a therapy for hypertension after disappointing trial results had weakened market belief.

‍

Through a two-year engagement program we:

‍

Re-told the story – A four-part documentary educating physicians on RDN.

‍

Announced new results – Live coverage of the pivotal trial results at the ACC congress.

‍

Educated the community – A sustained expert-led program.

‍

Localized efforts – Engaging local healthcare communities in six languages.

‍

The campaign reached 4 million healthcare professionals, resulted in 117k content views, and drove a fivefold increase in searches for RDN. By 2022, 12 leading hypertension societies had reached a consensus supporting RDN as a complementary therapy.
body2:
The primary challenges Medtronic faced in this project were:

‍

Loss of Market Confidence – After an initial promising trial, a disastrous second study created doubt about Renal Denervation (RDN) as an effective hypertension treatment.

‍

Skepticism in the Medical Community – The negative trial results led to reduced trust among healthcare professionals and hypertension societies.

‍

Need for Re-Education – With the release of new Off-Med trial results in 2020, Medtronic needed to rebuild awareness and trust by getting the updated facts in front of key audiences.

‍

Global Awareness & Adoption – To establish RDN as a complementary therapy, they needed to engage physicians, societies, and local healthcare providers worldwide.
body3:
We executed a two-year engagement program in four key phases to rebuild confidence in Renal Denervation (RDN) and drive adoption:

‍

Re-Telling the Story – Created a four-part documentary to educate physicians and reframe the narrative around RDN with factual, compelling storytelling.

‍

Announcing New Trial Results – Covered the Pivotal trial results live from the ACC congress, providing downloadable content to reinforce credibility.

‍

Sustained Expert-Led Education – Launched an ongoing educational program featuring leading experts to re-engage the medical community.

‍

Localized Community Engagement – Expanded outreach to local healthcare providers in six languages, connecting RDN experts with GPs to build regional support networks.

‍

This strategic approach reached millions of healthcare professionals, re-established trust in RDN, and led to global hypertension societies validating RDN as a complementary therapy.
body4: With over 4m hypertension impressions on the platform and 23m people reached through off-platform promotion, we clocked up an impressive 117k views of the content, as well as instigated a fivefold increase in searches for RDN. And with our help, by 2022, the 12 leading global hypertension societies had all announced consensus on the validity of RDN as a complementary therapy for controlling hypertension.
